text: Garbage!. I bought these to put a small bulletin board on my fridge. The adhesive didn’t work and 6 magnets weren’t strong enough to hold the board - it just slid right off. My son stuck a few of the other magnets on the fridge by themselves and they broke in half! And to top it off, these magnets aren’t eligible to be returned. What a waste!
The O-ring seal blew out!! This item is now useless.. The O-ring seal blew out!! This item is now useless. Leaks everywhere!!!

Way too short = can't get nozzle anywhere near buildplate. Writing before filing for return so i can go try similar product from these guys' competition.
As the title says, these are stupid short: 2-3 millimeters shorter than necessary. Moved limit switch til it was barely attached & still can't get nozzle anywhere close to the bed. Description mentions downloading some thingiverse files, but thingiverse (as always) isn't working right now, and it also mentions that's not needed for ender3. Designing/printing spacers is a simple enough fix, just ridiculous that they can't design these to the right size before selling & wastimg customers' time.
As a side note, and afterthought to this review, the included plastic cable guide is a joke. It's 3d printed, underextrusion on every facet and has poor layer adhesion. I'd expect to see all that in a benchy, not a product already marketed and shipping to consumers.

These bottles leak when tipped upside down. When it .... These bottles leak when tipped upside down. When it is floating around in my purse, it leaks all over the place. It is leaking through the spray top. Very unhappy.

Need better packing inspection. Trays arrived with some dents, cheap tin looking sent them right back. Need better packing inspection. Was NOT happy...this caused a huge inconvenience in what I needed them for. Not worth the price.
Ear bands too short. Break very easy. Do not recommend.. Ear bands too short and break easily. Junk!
Doesn't work, am I missing updated drivers? (Oct 2020). Installed it properly, tried to install firmware, it didn't work, and now it has no pause function, and jerks everytime it starts up.

Rating change from 5 to 2. Updated 4/13/20 Just open pkg to use for the first time. Disappointed! They have a very small amount of adhesive on them. Only stay on for a short period of time. Forget about sleeping with them on. Will try another manufacturer next time.
I still have a few originals that came with my TENS. These look like they will work fine.
More than happy a friend recommended "dry needling" to me. Hope I won't need my TENS machine very often since procedure.
used this in my Jeep for my sub. Did .... used this in my Jeep for my sub. Did the job but is rusted after just one trip to the beach!
Nano Magic for removing car scratches. There is no sparkle in it and it does not remove any scratches, at least not the tiny scratches that I had!

VERY SHORT. I bought these to mix 1-3 quarts of epoxy resin without wearing out my arm from stirring. I expected them to be large enough to stir more than an 8oz cup, but alas, these stirrers are small and flimsy and are barely 6 inches long. I will be looking for something better. Save your money on these unless you only want to mix a tiny amount of resin in a very small cup.

Unassembled product; did not look like the picture presented in the advertisement.. This product arrived....UNASSEMBLED. VARIOUS PARTS....SCREWS, HANGING PIECES, ALL SCATTERED ALL OVER THE PLACE. IT WAS NOT INCLUDED IN THE DESCRIPTION OF THE PRODUCT THAT IT IS BEING SOLD, UNASSEMBLED AND THAT THE BUYER HAS TO ASSEMBLE AND PUT TOGETHER THE BITS AND PIECES OR PARTS, OF THE WHOLE ITEM. I WOULD NEVER HAVE ORDERED THIS UNASSEMBLED PRODUCT. I DUMPED THE WHOLE THING IN THE GARBAGE.

Ordered this and was sent M12 x 1.75!. This tap worked very well at cutting new threads in my BMW's wheel hub. Unfortunately I was sent a M12 x 1.75 size tap! The bag was labeled as a M12 x 1.5 tap so I proceeded to re-tap the lug bolt hole on my wheel hub. Obviously the lug bolt does not want to go into this new hole. Awesome.

Most taps I have are labeled with the size AND the thread pitch. This was labeled only "M12". I can see how this alone would have contributed to this mistake, but when dealing with machine tools this kind of oversight is inexcusable. I have contacted Amazon about this so hopefully between them and the seller (uxcell) this will get resolved. Somebody owes me a new wheel hub, and installation.
Easy to bend maybe good for dentist nothing else.. Easily bends but very sharp and pointy this would 9nly be useful for delicate things anything else will cause it to bend.

Revising review to 1 star. Two Radex ONE failed.. I have two. Originally rated 5-star. A mistake, changing my rating to 1 star.
Very poorly made. Many points of failure on both. Buttons braking off ON BOTH, display glass unglued on one (it is held by sticky stuff, not strongly at all), geiger tube wire broke on one and needed soldering. So, it was not a case of one bad unit. It's how they are really built.

Both of mine are no longer in use.

I'm not interested in Radex responses to this message like "contact us and we will make you happy and replace your unites". Not another Radex.

I found better detectors from other manufacturers, which are my present work horses & they have no reliability issues. There're good manufacturers and solid instruments around if you do some research. Q-safe, Polimaster series and AtomFast to give a few examples.

Not usable. The lamp arrived with its bulb loose, and short of drilling through the broken-off screw holding the case shut, there is no way to fix or replace the bulb. The lenses are too large for the riders.

Absolutely amazing... at first, but then worthless.. Absolutely amazing, at first. I instantly could put together ceramic dishes, broken glass, wood, plastic, you name it. It would only take 20 seconds.
However, it was too good to last. Almost everything we have glued has fallen apart again. This is much like super glue, but faster to dry and easier to handle, but like super glue, the bonds are very brittle and can handle very little. We have even found that ceramics we glue fall apart on their own after a few weeks.
It will not adhere to many plastics. It just pulls off the wood fibers when attached there. Breaks off fabrics or flexible objects.
Good for a quick, short lived, fix.
11/17 update. Nothing we have glued with this held together more than a few days. I had originally purchased another vial of glue but the original and the replacement both will not activate any longer with the uv light. It appears that the adhesive doesn't have a very long shelf life.
scrached windsheild!. Used this for one week and now my SR22 has scratches in the windshield. Back to Plexus ASAP!!!! Screw You Prist!!

One size fits all.....but..... I guess this was designed for any size shop-vac. I have a 12 gallon vac. The paper filter is at least three inches too tall. I assume that won’t matter. Unfortunately, the rubber band provided was dry-rotted and broke before it was ever large enough to go around the filter. Now I have to go find large rubber bands before I can use my shop-vac. Must have been sitting somewhere for years.

No what to ask if I could get the software. I didn't get the original software. My board came blank. It was also missing the sd card.
And have no way of asking for it.

Prepare to buy a crimp tool and JST-XH Connector. It’s missing screw terminals for the fan wires, so you either have to cram the fan wires under your source power wires (no thank you), or go buy a crimp tool and JST-XH connectors to get your fan connected to the terminals on the board.
They should’ve just included a JST-XH pigtail and some B connectors.
Far from plug and play. No instructions included, and the PCB isn’t well labeled. It’s difficult to determine the polarity of some of the critical connectors, and which is the Hot End, and which is the Bed.

Apparently the documentation, is the product photos where they label things in one of the photos - still no polarity, so I had to go to YouTube to avoid letting out the magic smoke.

Junk. These are the cheapest, weakest screws I've ever used. They stripped so horribly and wouldnt even turn in a predrilled hole without being so stripped they were worthless prior to getting into the hole completely. I ended up wasting about twenty of them and a ton of frustration before stopping mid-project to go to the hardware store to buy decent screws. Surprise, surprise, the new screws I bought were a half inch longer yet went in seamlessly and didnt strip a single bit. I pulled back out all but four of these awful screws twisting with pliers because they were too stripped to get out. Then I easily drove the hardware store nails with my drill and completed the project in five minutes. What junk!

Poorly made but does the job. Its great for it intended purpose but its very cheap and very light. So light that it falls over easily. I purchased it to hold angel wings I purchased and I don't know if this thing will even hold them. The foot pieces are cheap plastic that wouldn't hold much weight, the velvet is slightly damaged. The top "head piece" couldn't be screwed in because there was hot glue in the screw hole. I had to carve it out for it to screw on.

Inconsistent Quality. Ordered two. One was perfect, finished well, accurate jaw alignment. The other was junk, clearly a different manufacturer, despite identical bagging. Poor finish, weak clamp, misaligned jaws. It's why I ordered two, I figured one would be good.

Do not recommend. I am not sure if I got a defective pack of bottles. I noticed upon arrival, one bottle was mashed in but seemed usable (no cracks or holes). All the bottles came with super long spray tubes. Not a big deal - I can cut them down to size right? Except they packed the tubes inside the bottles, which left the tubes bent and one was cracked. Then the one bottle, that wasn’t mashed and did not have a cracked sprayer tube, I used only to discover that it leaks around the nozzle and trigger areas. With the nozzle completely closed and the sprayer screwed on tightly, I turned the bottle on its side and discovered it leaks. these bottles are overpriced for the quality and quantity. You are honestly better off buying a spray bottle capable of holding chemicals from Walmart. I think I found a 32 oz there, near the automotive items for like $4.

Yeah I guess it works, but that's it... (not a good thing). Pros:
- Your bed heats up a little quicker
- You are less likely to burn yourself since the bottom is covered
- Less energy required to stay hot

Cons:
- On the Ender 3 Pro, it's too thick that it warps the bed in the center
- You try to compress it by lowering the bed and now every corner is unleveled
- After 1 ABL, it's already unleveled again
- Too thick, it hits the Y motor (need to compress it or cut a piece off to work)
- Adhesive on the edges aren't good

Spent 2 days with upgraded springs and silicone bed mounts and it would not stay leveled or even come close to being leveled. One corner would always be close to 0.0" while all the other corners were somewhere between -0.1" to 0.4". It was the most frustrating thing ever that I even considered writing a review for. The moment I took it off, all my problems went away.

TL;DR: Yeah your bed heats up faster, barely, but you run into a world of trouble. Stay away.
Cheap. The utensils were very thin and bent when you tried to use the fork! I had to buy a whole new set from the grocery store instead.

Don't be misled by the box in the ad. Very disappointed.

Saw the ad for several colorful varieties and ordered a box. But when they arrived, they were all one, clearly non-unisex variety.

Not surprisingly, when you tap on the box in my order list you are shown the same varieties I originally ordered.

leaks. I bought two of these to go with my sheet cakes. They don't meet the pan at the corners and has gaps where batter would leak out making them completely unusable. I returned both that I purchased and plan to find some from somewhere at some point and will try again.

Does nothing. I purchased this because it says it get rid of grease and oil. I put it to the test. My power chair broke a seal on the gear box and leaked 90 weight gear oil all over the carpet before i realized it. I followed the instructions to the letter. I let it set 30 seconds and then blotted it with a white towel. It removed nothing. I tried it several times and it didn't even faze the grease. I then used my carpet cleaner with solution and it barely did anything either. I then commence to use diesel fuel on the stain with a clean rag and it removed the entire stain. there were 10 gobs of grease and now they are all gone using diesel fuel without any harm to the carpet. This product is junk in my opinion and i won't ever buy again. What a waste of good money!

update: I used my carpet cleaner again after using the diesel fuel and you can't tell the carpet was ever stained.
Bent on first use. The first time I used them we put a total of 200 lbs on all 4 and they bent and flattened out. Such a waste...

The handle is too fat and the tip bends. For the price of this product I expected a heavy duty tool, what I have is a foam handled stick with a brass colored "hook" that has bent itself out of shape within 10 minutes of pulling logs around the yard.

If this tool interests you I suggest going to the hardware store and building one yourself by cutting a wooden shovel handle to 30 inches in length, and drill a long fat screw through it so the screws pointy end is exposed for at least 3 inches. Doing so will cost a fraction of this "tool" and will work just as good.

What has four legs but can't stand still?. THIS SINK!

This sink is completely unbalanced and tips over just by looking at it.

The nut that screws the drain tailpiece to the drain basket would not go on tight enough to create a seal. It does not have enough teeth to screw on for a seal. I tried with and without the washer. Will need a new basket strainer.

The inside of the legs were rusted.

A few mills of water was left on the sink overnight and there is now a tiny mark of rust (corrosion).

It leaks!. Took for every to get this because somehow Amazon lost the original shipment.

I got it today, put it together and installed it. The install was into a Lowes round 10 gallon igloo cooler. It went pretty easy, using only the teflon tape the valve came with, washer, and nut. I reused the rubber gasket and plastic washer that was in the cooler.

Now for the leak test... I poured 3 gallons of water in the cooler to check for leaks.. I didn't see any leaks around the bulkhead or where I jointed the nipple to the valve. But I have a leak.. it's really slow, but it's there...

Watching it for a min, I noticed water coming out the valve.. ... sure nuff.... I guess the valve just isn't a water tight fit... I'm going to see if it gets worse, or not.. possibly stop?? Don't know.. but I have to rate it 1 star because it leaks through the valve itself..

Anyone know if there's anything I can do to stop a leak like this?

Missing pieces... But still an awesome tool!. I purchased 2 sets of these rods. Both were missing pieces. Disappointing. For this reason 2 stars.
Otherwise a nice product. Each rod appears to be accurate in size and shape.
Still a great tool for teaching math concepts. I learned with them 50 years ago. I'm excited using this tool to teach my 5 year old granddaughter who is now learning multiplication. And building towers. Lol

Careful, no reverse polarity protection. Accidentally misread the markings when putting a battery in and got it backwards, and it let the smoke out of the thing. They could have added diode reverse polarity protection for about 1 cent, but that's how cheaply this thing is built.
the thread is not US NPT but British BPST 1/8 BEWARE. the thread is not US NPT but British BPST 1/8 BEWARE NOT USA STANDARD

Don't let the looks fool you. This looks like a solid piece of metal in the picture but it's actually a hollow tube. The steel on the flange is maybe 10 gauge and the tubing with the screw threads is a little lighter It does seem to be fairly strong though. I needed to place a mailbox post and hit a layer of shale about 10" deep. I beat the snot out of it with a sledge hammer trying drive it deeper and it didn't break so that says something for it.

Piece of Junk - waste of money. Broke on first use. Seemed to start out OK but when drawing the hone backward the two "arms" holding the abrasive material broke away from the main shaft. It seems they are held on by a thin piece of plastic just a bit more rugged than a drinking straw.

Actually its construction makes no sense - the shaft end that fits into the drill is very heavy duty, as is the flexible spring and the adjustable compression spring on the main shaft. The "business" end however is just cheap crap. Don't waste your money unless you want to throw it away. Buy "Flex-Hones" instead.

Wrong size, wrong material, different brand.. Not sure what went on here but what I received was 3mm and not TPU and the spool does not seem to match what is shown here. Unfortunately, it was a gift and the return tag has got misplaced. I'm not very happy.

Be careful.. After installing this valve it leaked and when I went to remove it the valve came apart. The O ring got damaged and trying to find a new O ring was almost impossible. Wound up going to the local hardware store to buy a new valve.

Soft metal, strip out easily. I purchased these t-nuts for mounting subwoofer speakers into a speaker box baffle. Unfortunately I found these to be quite soft and very easy to strip out the threads. I did have success when using a c-clamp and then being careful when hand tightening but every time I used a power drill or impact, I stripped the t-nut and had to replace.

what pple will do for a dollar. I will count myself among the pple who use amazon to complain about the rest of life. Yeah, what pple will do for a dollar. This seller sent a tube of this crap that is half of an inch tall . It is like something in a dollhouse. There is a tenth of an ounce in this. There are no instructions included even in the tiny writing on the tube. It stinks and there is no way to see if it works bec there are no guidelines. I just tossed it in the garbage. Again what is the point of these pple doing this other than to just steal a dollar from unsuspecting pple who they trick with their obvious attempt at making this look like a large tube. If they showed a picture of this tube being held the hand would look like a king king hand. Hey heres an idea why not actually produce something useful.
Broke so quickly but not quick enough to return. This machine worked perfectly for about a month then it completely broke and wouldn’t work at all. Wish I could return it but broke a little too late

Inner tube bent and cracked. Replaced.. Easy to use but didn't last long. The tube inside was longer than it needed to be, which resulted in it becoming bent and cracked. Ended up having to order completely different spray bottles to replace it.

Very disappointing. Not sturdy at all. Looks solid, but it doesn't clearly state what it is made out of. Snapped easily in a short time. I suggest only buying these sort of things that are made out of solid brass. You might have a chance of it lasting longer.

Not really a good solution to fix a chipped black quartz countertop. Had a small chip on my new black quartz countertop and bought this to fix it..it really didn’t have good instructions on how to mix the adhesive and fuller together and then after it sets for 3 hours they say to sand paper down the filling you just made but ona. Black quartz top u see the scratches now from the sand paper..don’t bother with this if u have a dark countertop

Lightweight construction.. Came delivered w dents & chipped paint on bottom opposite sides. Bubble wrapped, probably should have been in a box. Product is nowhere near what I used when I was growing up.

Meh.... These worked for my purpose, but the 8-32 thread is not accurate. The 8-32 bolts that come with my cabinet knobs threaded freely for the entire length of the bolt; however, these turned 2-3 threads before they turned no further. I thought that my cabinet knobs may have come with a different thread, but tested them with a big box store sizing block and they worked perfectly.

Defective cap, twice!. If you don't use the whole tube, the cap will break. Happened twice already. I already lost 2 tubes because I only used a small amount and saved the rest, when I went back to use it, the cap was broken, see picture.

Unfortunately, not very good quality vinyl disposable gloves.. Packaging, thin cardboard, tore up trying to open it. I presume machine packed 100, very cheap quality, disposable vinyl gloves into packaging? Very Thin cardboard packaging tore completely apart..
I suggest do not waste your money.
Thrsr gloves, are unfortunately, useless for my personal needs.
Not leak proof. Leaks when sprayed. Not good quality. Bought because advertised as leak proof and it isn't. Leaks when sprayed.

Broke After Only A Few Times. Used only a few times for a move last month but the spring that holds and releases one of the wheels broke this morning when I tried to move a couple of things on my patio. This broken wheel makes the cart totally useless. I am very disappointed because I read the reviews carefully and chose the model with the fewest negative reviews.

Only bend to 24 degrees. These are very poorly designed. I can't imagine what they're useful for. I needed the kind of hinge that BENDS. This is the kind of hinge that bangs into itself. Did anyone look at it before calling it a product? It would partially work if it had screws with much smaller heads.

I live somewhere that Prime delivery takes 5 days (at junction of two interstate highways, 3 hours from Amazon HQ), so these worse-than-useless hinges set my project back by that number of days.

They are also very badly MADE. They are the cheapest cast metal made of whatever was in the scrapyard that day (molten soup cans mixed with molten batteries would be my guess). Mine were not even capable of supporting their own weight.

The casting must have been done at a foundry that normally makes manhole covers or buckets for mining excavators. It's okay to be off by 0.25 inch when something is 20 feet tall, but not when it's 0.25 inches tall.

Not worth it!. I purchased this to use for studying for finals. I opened it about 2 weeks or so after it arrived and the mandible springs had popped off and the rod for keeping it upright broke as soon as I put it together. I didn’t have time to wait for a new one as I needed it as a study aide. The return window closed 2 days ago and now I’m stuck with a $300 piece of crap. Not worth it!!! Very disappointed.

Really cheap, not as described, stay away.. This doesn't seem like it's stainless steel but rather zinc plated. It is not like the pictures shown and doesn't seem very durable. The nuts on the wire rope tension started peeling when I was using my pliers to tighten them. I have others that are truly stainless steel and they don't peel. The sides of the turnbuckle are thin, feel cheap, and some of them are bent. See pictures, or better yet, choose another product.

Waste. A big fat 0 for stars. They're super strong as long as you move them in certain ways. But I feel like I just bumped something next to them and they broke. I attempted screws and they broke. Put them together? They broke. I have one functional magnet left out of the 4 and I haven't even gotten close to applying them in my project and definitely won't even try now. I'm glad my kids weren't in the room, because the magnet shards shot through the room and could've taken out someone's eye.

Also, if you wanted them to stick to each other in one of your projects, there are no opposite magnets. You have to install the steel bracket face down on the other side. Since the screw holes are only counter sunk on the one side of the magnet, you would have to countersink screws into the steel plate on the bottom of the next one to get a flush magnetism (without breaking the magnet or killing someone).

Definitely too good to be true. The outdoor faucet in my backyard cracked and is spraying water. Got this thinking it could seal it up, as that is what the commercial and all the marketing for this stuff says. It may as well have been normal packing tape. Does not seal the crack, does not adhere to pipes - the tape stayed on for about 3 seconds with water coming out from the edges before it was thrown off. Don't waste your time or money with this.

thread axis is not parallel to nut axis. Terrible machine work, but it won't ruin my project. I already intended to turn off the hex shape on the lathe, and while I'm at it, I can correct the skewed thread-to-external axis.

There's a very noticeable 1-3º pitch between the external shape and the threaded internal on every one of these. The thread does a decent job of coupling with M6 screws I have on hand, so I don't have to return them. I'll just thread them onto a long M6 rod and trim the ends to be truly perpendicular to the main axis. You know, like any sane person would expect this part to be in the first place.

The price should be much lower for this quality. Potentially unusable for some applications if you don't have a lathe to correct them.

There's a SCREW MISSING!. The box was smashed and torn, particularly at the corners. The cart was only slightly scratched at the bottom of the handle near the elbow joint, better than you would expect after seeing the box. Disappointed when I discovered 1 bolt and washer missing. That means one caster will only have 3 bolts to hold it on rather than the 4 that it supposed to have. My husband and I triple checked the packaging...and it's confirmed MISSING.

Don't both with this one. Spend more to get the real deal.. Bought this for use in our incident command post and its crap - no better than duct tape Cords that were tapes down needed to be redone within a day, We used this to tack up org charts, maps and other essential intel and they all fell down overnight. Replaced with Pro Gaff tape and everything has been tacked up or tacked down for weeks now. Its more expensive, but well worth it and a better value since it actually works.

Photo safe but not paper safe.. I used these dots to attach the photos in my children's baby books. After only four years there are stains on the back of the paper opposite where the dots were applied. See the attached photos. Looks like grease or water spots on every page of their keepsake books. Sometimes these dots are right where I wrote loving memories. The dots damaged the paper.

I cannot imagine what it will look like in 50+ years. I'm going to have to buy new books, reprint all the photos, and rewrite everything I put in the books. That will cost a lot more than the box of dots. So upset.

I didn't have any trouble with the box dispenser though.

I do not recommend these for anything you want to keep for more than a year like scrapbooks or memory books.

the material inside is cheap it has no resistance to make deliverys. Two weeks after using it in my deliveries, it no longer worked, it was breaking on the edges at the bottom, the material of the product is very cheap and is not made to be resistant to make deliveries I was disappointed!!

Didn’t work for me. Bought this for $19.99. Used it with my 2,000 PSI pressure washer hoping to remove pee stains on my backyard patio pavers. Well the pee stains are still there and overall the pavers did not look much cleaner than they were before. Maybe it is because I’ve only had the pavers for 2-3 months. I just thought if I’d pressure clean the pee stains frequently that the pavers would be cleaned. Not the case. I did have some success by spraying Clorox urine remover and letting it dry on the affected pavers. Also I was surprised this Simply Green concrete cleaner did not remove small grease stains and small rust spots on the pavers. Weird. Also at Lowe’s about two weeks later I saw a product like this for $12.99 which is a better price.

Did Not Work Well. I used JB Weld for metal and they were excellent. I ordered the JB Weld for plastic when the plastic handle of my jumper cable (made in China) broke hoping that, with the name JB Weld, it could fix my problem. After applying weld to the broken piece, I let it sit for a couple of days to make sure that the bond would have hardened by then. After two days, I tried to open the clamp and it broke at the bonded joint. I was disappointed and bought a new clamp (more money as they come in pairs) instead.

Waste of money,-scam. These look good, but, don't be fooled. The screwheads won't fit any Philips driver insert that I could find. I finally took a #1 and ground the tip to get the driver blades a little deeper. (an old trick.) That didn't work well, but sorta worked. A #2 bit would just tear up the screw head. I threw away a couple dozen screws that stripped their heads. A POOR product. Shame on them!

Dissapointed - to put it mildly. I was excited to finally get my hands on some rainbow and then the day arrived, quickly ripped open the box so I could print like a madman and I was stopped dead in my tracks and overcome with dissapointment.

Color is way darker than shown. It is multicolor but more like rust red and green almost like left over christmas spools. Well it was shiny enough and I was like SCREW IT lets see what it looks like in print.....

Adhesion was tricky until I bumped my hot end up to 230 degrees C. then it adhered very well. Overall not impressed with the final product. To be fair I made a few adjustments and I am trying one final print and will attach the photo in about 4 more hours lol.

If you are looking for the colors shown do not be suprised if it looks completely different - it was kind of close but unless this final print is magical.... To Be Updated soon

Round peg in a square hole?. I was skeptical these would work as advertised, but lacking an alternative I purchased with the intent of putting casters on my coffee table. Sure enough, when installing 2 didn't even hold the casters in place when the table was tipped on the side. So I tried a bottom-up installation with the table right-side up. As soon as any weight was applied to the legs, the casters and inserts all busted out of the tubing. (1"OD, 7/8"ID legs.) And it will cost over $10 shipping to return an $8 item. >:(
Exterior has great appearance and dimensions fit end of 1"OD leg perfectly. If only they worked....

Not as described.. This says it is 1/2 NPT, but will not thread onto ANY showerhead fitting I attempt. Not a faucet diverter adapter, not an actual showerhead pipe, not a shower wand. I have other 1/2 NPT adapters that all work, and were listed the same. But this one does NOT.
Didn’t work for us. Bought to get lime stains off our hime where hose bib leaked. This did not do the job. Disappointed

SNAP CRACKLE POP!. These are junk. These are good at only 2 things pissing you off and taking your money.
Heads strip out almost immediately after cutter engages.
Majority of them strip out halfway into material and stay there!? Only way to fix is pry bar the damned thing out. Because it won’t go any further and won’t back out due to striped threads in the middle.
Also had a ton snap completely in half?
If you have a desired amount double the screw count you’ll need the extras. Trust me.

Multiple subpar parts. Never could get it working. Bad customer service.. The printer seems to have a good form factor, and while the materials are cheap, they look nice. The aluminum seems reasonable enough quality. However, the power supply came broken, and when I tried to ask them for a replacement, they stalled me and asked me to do tests and provide them with video evidence. Extremely poor customer service. One of the threaded bars also came bent. The foam packing material in the package was totally pulverized, and stuck on or inside of every part that was not in a bag.

NO MANUAL. NO MANUAL. NO MANUAL. (And nothing on the web...). Unit arrived on time and in good shape (thanks to the seller).
On unpacking... there IS NO MANUAL.
There is a "sheet" of paper that purports to maybe being the manual, but it simply lists features.
NOWHERE on the world wide web can I find support or a manual for this unit!!! This is just wrong!
Now, this is a simple machine... but setting AMPS is a tricky deal. Amps can only be set under a load. Many anecdotal internet sources recommend clipping the positive and negative alligator clips TOGETHER to set the Amps. Isn't that like shorting out a battery?
Geeesh... how hard would it have been to put a basic manual in the box?
Unusable-low quality. The adhesive keeping the threaded nut in the nylon was completely useless. These are only good for returning.

Very frustrating. Bought this as it is stainless and my current brass OEM bolts corroded and started leaking. One of the new bolts would not go into the hole in the toilet base. Thin paper with adhesive voids. My biggest question when ordering these was the adhesive... I've had a Zebra printer for many years, and have seen quite a range of quality when it comes to labels from random online vendors.

My first impression when opening these was "thin paper," but they seemed to adapt well to boxes or bubble mailers. I have a couple of test labels stuck to things, and will update this review if they misbehave over time.

UPDATE JANUARY 2023:

I am not at all happy with these labels. It started with one that had a persistent bubble from top to bottom, and I started looking at the adhesive... many labels in a row with a long central void lacking any adhesive at all. Whether this is a fluke with just part of my roll or a more chronic problem, I don't know, but I am now wary of them (and just reprinted another one for a customer shipment). The photo shows the effect... once adhered to the package, the label area without adhesive backing bubbles up and cannot be convinced to flatten.

I just discarded the roll, and recommend avoiding these.

Activator is a pen, not a spray, AND it was totally dried up. I have several repairs I wanted to complete with this, but they are all now on hold because the product shipped to me had no moisture in the activator pen. After I failed to get any moisture at the tip of the pen, I opened it up and found that there is a big sponge inside and that the sponge was almost totally dry. There was no liquid in evidence.

I managed to push and push and push on the wick that sticks out and was able to get enough activator out to complete one repair over a pinhole I had accidentally created in the tube of a vacuum sealer.

Finally, all the other CA activators I've ever seen are spray-on applicators. This wick approach has advantages for situations where you want to control where the activator goes, but it makes it impossible to do other repairs where you can't disturb the part by pushing on it. (With this dried up activator, I had to push hard enough that I actually pushed the wick all the way back into the tube).

Bottom line: don't buy this.

Common sizes of screws are #6, #8, and #10, with #12 being very heavy duty.

My conclusion, this beast of a 300lbs magnet can hold 55lbs before detachment from the plate. I repeated this experiment several times with the same results and then with a polished steel plate and same results. Is is a good magnet, yeah, it is. Is it a cheap magnet, yeah, it is. One Star for now - but figured out how to get it to 5 stars. I have purchased PLA plus before (This is called PLA Pro). my big mistake was to follow the manufacturing guidelines on print settings. The reel - the paper inserted into the package all said to print at 180-220. IT WOULD NOT ADHEAR after using all the tricks in the book. The web site said try lowering the temperature, so I tried that - even worse!!!! I swapped back to regular PLA and the machine worked great.
I was about to return it, and read the 1 star reviews - and their is was - print hotter. I jacked the nozzle up to 221 degrees, the bed up to 65 and it was like magic. I am now printing 5 star maze boxes and small Christmas trees. WOW - Great filament - but TERRIBLE INACCURATE documentation. I have liked Overture prints in the past and have been pleased by those.
Thank you to the others who figure this out in the 1 star reviews.

A necessary tool, with terrible design.. The purpose of this tool is to measure threads on rotating fasteners. That means that if the thread you're trying to measure is fixed in place, then you must rotate this tool. As if to make that as difficult as possible, the manufacturers of this product have connected all the different size pieces to each other on a cable. These parts are loose on the cable and slide all around. This is the most unwieldy thing you could have attached to a tiny threaded part that you are trying to rotate while maintaining correct alignment to the thing you're trying to measure so the threads catch. If they don't catch, you have to guess whether it's because it's the wrong size or just because the weight of the cable knocked the threads out of alignment while you were trying to rotate them. What a nightmare!

The only way to get the pieces off the cable is to cut it, and the only reason I haven't done that yet is because at least on the cable they're in order. As soon as I can find a good case for them I'm losing this GD cable!

Other than that this seems to be the best tool of its kind available.

Useless for pool maintenance. Pool phosphate maintenance requires you to keep your pool under 100ppb (billion) and to start severe measures at 1ppm (million). These strips measure phosphorOUS from 0 to 100 ppm -- meaning phosphATE from 0 to 300 ppm -- and the first color standard is at 30ppm phosphATE, making them useless. Two immediately subsequent reads from the same bottle of water today registered 0 and 300ppm (both ends of the scale), while a professional pool product accurately measured 500ppb. Incidental gripe is that this product advertises "Long plastic strips ensure you can keep your fingers away from what is being tested," which would be true except half the strips are loaded in the tube upside-down. Just not a quality product.

I Had Difficulty Using This Drill Bit.. This step drill bit is very difficult to use when cutting a hole in thin metal. I recommend that you first drill a pilot first to ensure placement of step drill bit; otherwise, the bit on the step drill is likely to wobble out of place or alignment. The step bit has a tendency to catch and jerk while drilling. This might be solved by placing the item to be drilled on a hard surface or clamping the item to be drilled in a very tight manner. After one use the bit is now dull and cannot be used without problems drilling another hole in future projects. I had to use a small rotary drill with metal cutting and grinding bits to get the proper diameter and roundness needed for hole. The step bit will work one time if you are careful.

not for me. For my use it does more scratching than buffing as well as the sisal comes out and gets all over everything in the shop. Evidently the term buffing wheel is a misnomer. I've been buffing bone and the cloth works a lot better.
Doesn’t work well. Tried to use two of them and they broke on me .. I wouldn’t recommend this quality of product for clamping a hose.

Great but it leaks. My dog was sick in the morning and so I left it out near a towel. 1000 lbs where? 75 lbs at best. I was getting some flooring replaced so I had to temporarily move a 300 lb mirrored wood cabinet maybe 10 ft. I thought these would help my husband’s back. Horribly disappointed. Returned immediately. Only one arrived in tact. Horribly disappointed. Returned immediately.
Didn’t work for me.. I bought this product to stop a leak in my pool pump and it didn’t work. Regular Plumbers Putty worked better.

Not good. I bought the 2X2 dura stick premium pads a year ago. The blue jelly oozes out and gets stuck on my clothes and furniture. Spring loaded casters. Weak load springs for any heavier doors and one of the four sent was frozen and had to be rebent to work without sticking. Other frustration was that their were no Wood screws with it.

flimsy junk - never fails to fail. This stuff is very thin and lightly reinforced. It doesn't stick where you want it too, but somehow manages to stick enough to leave a nasty residue when you don't want it to. It's not at all water resistant or cold-tolerant.

Very Poor Quality. The plastic studs break so easily and are just so crappy! Not accurate or usable for most thermal observations. Unfortunately this product is not what I had hoped for. Burst Out The Back Of The Tube !!. Had a real hard time getting any material to dispense from the 3 oz. tube. Double checked to make sure the tube didn't have an internal seal. JUNK. Thought to neither one of them work Baltimore junk when I took them out of the box neither one work box arrived not sealed and had return ticket on them on the box were seem like someone at John order them and open them and return them neither one of them work

Misleading Description. The description reads "stainless steel, but both the shears and the knife has already begin to show rust. Not sure.... We received the trash can. We were so excited! When we pulled the trash can out it was dented and it was missing the power cord. Since we don’t have a power cord, we are unable to use the motion sensor.

This product may cause damage to your diesel motor from Zinc flaking off inside the tank. We emailed Justrite and they never responded!!!!!! Not worth it.. The only brush I found useful for my fountain was the really small one for the pump. Wasted money, buy something better. For some reason I can review just the "head" of the unit when I bought the whole thing. Don’t buy this. Total crap. The adhesive fell off, the plastic part kept coming off, it scratched the crap out of my neck.

The screw fittings leak.. I bought this hose for extra length on a river water suction intake for an irrigation pump. The hose itself was the same good quality hose I have purchased previously from other sources. However, both screw fittings leaked - not just drips, but a stream of water (even when not under pressure). I took the fittings apart and determined that the fitting's barb connector fit very loosely into the hose - the metal crimp around the barb simply could not compress the hose enough to make a seal. Fortunately, I had extra fittings from previous hoses which fit snugly into the hose and made a proper seal. The manufacturer must have tried to save money by buying cheap, ill-fitting screw fittings. No, I would not purchase from this source again.

Not working as well as expected.. I'm having to pump the Sphygmomanometer several times before it even starts to pump up. Frustrating. I should have returned it.

Don’t buy! Cheaply made. Cheaply made, 2 of the yellow basket broke before while hanging them in the beg board.

Could Have Been A Great Product. I had to get a refund on this product, not because the quality of the bottles were bad but because half the lids didn't fit. Broke in less than 2 months. Some did not work. I am no stranger to command strips and quite familiar with the necessary steps taken to ensure that they adhere. It arrived in odd packaging that was in an envelope, not the thick plastic we normally get like in stores. I thought it was to just save on packaging, so I ignored my own judgement. I initially thought I didn’t line up the strips correctly, but how could that be since I pressed them on to each other and heard it lock. Price right but 1st failed initial tests 2nd passed test.. Liked the fact it was water resistant, 12 volt and easy to install into the 3/8" tubing. so much like my old Eureka Vac. It works very well on my rugs and tile love the bag feature to filter the air. My home don't smell dusty after using it!! Not that reflective. I've purchased other reflective tape from different manufacturers and I was disappointed with this product. I feel that other products you might see have more reflectiveness to them and this product fell short on delivering that.

poor quality control. very fine thread so it can be hard to get nuts started in tight conditions. My opinion is most are not even threaded correctly. brittle. spend a little extra for a different product. Unlike similar brands, the tips of these twist and break if the hole isn't large enough. 3M Marine Adhesive Sealant Fast Cure 5200. With so many reviews that talk about how great an adhesive this is for marine use, I gave it a try. I was making a transducer mount for my boat using 2 pieces of 1/2" polycarbonate plastic joined with this 5200 in a generous amount. I clamped it together for a week, inside. I then used the 5200 to adhere the polycarb to my boat transom with good clamping force for 2 days. I then proceeded to mount my transducer onto the ploycarb with 1 inch stainless screws. As soon as the screw came into the 2nd layer of polycarb, the two pieces separated! Not only did it separate but after more than a week, the 5200 was still wet/hadn't cured! I ended up cleaning all of the 5200 off my 2 pieces and rejoined them with a different marine adhesive and then mounted the transducer to the polycarb with my screws. I allowed it to set up for two days and did a water test yesterday. The other adhesive worked great and I am back in business! I will never trust this 5200 for my boating needs. It is a very unreliable product that cannot be trusted.

ULTRA TINY STANDOFFS, SMALLER THAN ADVERTISED, NOT FOR COMPUTER MOTHERBOARDS..... NOT MOTHERBOARD BRASS STANDOFFS. I don't know what the world a "brass standoff" would otherwise be used for than a Computer Motherboard, but these are not it. Additionally, the measurements are NOT accurate. The standoff portion is 5mm, not 8mm. THE ENTIRE piece of brass from tip of last thread to the top of the largest portion is 8mm, which is the size of a motherboard standoff hex head portion.

SO, this is very misleading. I thought these would be good to be able to hand tighten since the hex head type require a tool and strip easily being brass. As it turns out, this was a BAD idea. The threads are smaller than 2mm as well, maybe 1mm. The threaded portion are so small they really can almost fit the tiny screws in your sunglasses as a joint screw.

VERY TINY standoffs. NOT for motherboards.
