This last mat delivered today pictured on the right shows a slick rubber edge which is unsafe and doesn’t match the others. I ordered from my last order invoice so I don’t know what happened. Buy Again doesn’t necessarily mean the item will the same again. That’s too bad.

Junk. Bought 1 a month previously, internal spring broke and wouldn't release stem switch. Received another, which just completely fell apart. These were used in an overhead stove exhaust fan light that only gets used a couple times a day.
Leaks!!. Replacing the cold water valve to our hot water heater. This leaks!! And when the handle is fully clised, a piercing stream of water shoots through - it doesn’t close the whole way!

Believe the bad reviews. It's not worth it.. The PTFE tube was less than half the length of the original one that came with the Vyper AND it was cut so that a small amount was hanging off when I pulled it out of the box. I had a replacement PTFE tube, so I thought to overlook this. After heating the nozzle up to proper temperature and attempting to remove it, the nozzle sheared off instantly. This is not a genuine part and the quality is worse than poor. You are getting scammed if you purchase this as a replacement.

abrasive burns off. i got these with high expectations of being able to shape wood and deburr and shape metal holes. i find that the abrasive will not withstand the heat generated while grinding or sanding with them. i found some 1/8 shaft endmills that work much better. they don't heat up as much and they are more aggressive they also cut harder materials but as a result, they are more brittle so they have to be handled more carefully. i do not recommend these for anything but maybe light sanding.
Simply did not work. I had a leaky pipe and they require the the area be dry but there was no way to stop the water. Tried the tape; same thing

Worse than not testing. I've had these come back positive one time outside the time window. Yet had positive results on other brands taken at the same time. They are horrible as they give a false sense of security and people will trust they are not sick and go about their life when infact they do have it.
We've taken these while still as sick as possible from covid and come back negative.
Weebles wobble, but they do fall down.. The metal part of this is pretty decent, but the hybrid rubber/plastic wheels -suck! Went to Hardware store and got some sturdy ones. Weeble no longer wobbles.

Poorly designed, only good for a few uses.. The thin plastic broke after a few uses, but the outside brush can still be used manually. The smaller inside brush does not attach to the metal rod in the center very well, but it still works. But after just a few uses, the inside brush has gotten smaller in diameter, so it doesnt work as well as it first did. .

Not real Command strips!. These strips come in a generic plastic bag with a "Command" sticker on it. I've used Command strips for years and always had reliable results and within 2 hours I had 3 broken frames and a busted baseboard trim piece with this set of strips. So, I think these are not real Command strips which usually are a fantastic product. I'm off to buy new frames and resign to using nails to hang them up.

Design flaw in the Smart Straw Spray Wand.. On the very first usage the Smart Straw Spray Wand pulled out the o-ring seal that makes the adjustable straw work. Looking closely at the spray wand sealing surface, I found a very small crack in the wand that ran across the entire surface and passed through the spray hole. This crack evidently snagged the o-ring. Without the o-ring the spray goes every way except through the wand.

Included wrench is junk. The wrench included to install is junk and rounds off too easily. I can’t find a narrow enough wrench to completely screw them in so all 4 have 1/2-3/4” gap short of full seating.

Waste of money. Not cut to size. In this picture you can see what came out of my flashforge creator pro next to this product in the bag. Not only are the the wrong length, they don’t fit inside so they are the wrong width as well. The seller probably bought PTFE tubing and measured the outer shell as the diameter of 1.75 instead of the inner diameter.

Listen, I can buy PTFE tubing myself and cut it for a fraction of what I was charged and in this case, when I needed tubing, that was exactly what I had to do, making this purchase absolutely worthless.

It is past the 30 day return period, because I bought this as a backup. I suggest you open your package right away and don’t make the same mistake.
Not well constructed. Not well constructed. Pins broke off first day. I wouldn't purchase this item again.
Poorly cut threads - leaks.. Female threads not cut properly. Leaks, even with plumbers tape. Difficult to tighten down enough to stop leak, given the poorly cut threads.

Used and damaged before use. Opened package and ph tester to find big crystals on the head, nozzle and cap of tester. Crystals usually mean the device was used incorrectly, returned and sold as new. Once Crystals form the device is ruined and unusable.

SUPER SHARP AND HORRIBLE PRODUCT!. Worse product to use! All the parts are super sharp, and when you open it to measure, the long thin part stretches out at the bottom, and is also super sharp! I also bought a nice Digital camera, and had these pieces in a container with some other stuff not realizing how sharp this item was, and it scratched the whole display lens! So it also damaged my new camera! Every time I try to use this gauge to measure watch dials, or other things, it keeps poking me, and it hurts. I don't know why it is so sharp, but it's like a sharp knife on each side, and the end piece that slides out. Don't get this if you don't want to be poked with a sharp object that can pierce your skin, or damage anything around it!! Wish I could get my money back, and them pay for my new camera!

Broken after minimal use. Worked well at the beginning. I only used it a handful of times before it sat on a shelf, untouched for a few months. I recently needed to use it but it's now broken. The display just keeps cycling random numbers and cannot be cleared or reset. It can only be powered off by removing the battery.

Very disappointed!!. Bought this to repair a PVC pipe plumbing on my pool there was a small leak , all it did was make the water run to a different spot all over the place it never stop the leak! All the claims are are not true!!! It did not work it's worthless not worth the money!!!! Very disappointed!!!☹️

just over one year old and broken. While the vacuum itself has worked okay since I purchased in October 2017, the sharp force needed to tilt the handle back has always bothered me on this machine. Welp, today the handle basically broke right off (the plastic attached to the base, which the handle mated with, cracked), rendering the entire thing a pile of junk. While the machine *theoretically* has a 5 year warranty, not sure I want to pursue that (dragging it to a service center, hassling over what's covered and not, and ending up spending any more money on this flawed design). More likely than not, I'll buy a replacement, but won't be looking at Bissell.

Very bad spooling. One of the worst spooling I've seen. It's like there was a kink every meter. I had to listen for string pulling sound and manually unroll the kink, but eventually I had to go sleeping. I didn't want to pause because it would cause stringing and small defect for translucent print when resume. Big mistake, next morning, the print stopped halfway and "finished" so no resume was possible. Apparently PETG filament is tough to break off, the roller probably was slipping on pulling the filament while it's continuing to print without filament could go through.
Now, whenever using this filament, I can't be away.
At 220C, it's very stringing which doesn't look good for translucent.
warping. printed a bird house 2 corners warped added panters tape printed a box same thing warped

Not the best filament. I am new to 3d printing but did a lot of research before jumping in. I bought an Ender 3 V2 and then a second printer that had larger print volumne. Since I had no frame of reference for filament, I chose different brands and some assorted colors as I got better as slicing and producing prints. Out of the 4 or 5 different brands accounting for, now 11 rolls of filament the ONLY one the break was this brand. I used the same mountiing, both on the printer and a filament holder with bearings, and the 3d Solutech spool broke not once but twice just in normal use and during a print job. The first ended up costing me a length of Capricon tubing. The other jammed in the printer head.

If you are looking for a cost effective choice for filament there are lots of others out there that may be a bit more expensive but won't have the same risk of breaking.

I would not recommend this brand.

LEAKS. These brass 3/4" tees leak no matter how much tape or pipe dope you apply. The seller site reads, "Designed for use in air, water, oil, nature, manufactured, mixed, liquefied petroleum or propane and LP Gas-Air." (Sic). It would be dangerous to use these for any application.

melted down mess. Do not buy this product online. Mine arrived with the adhesive melted all over the inside of the box. What a mess. I don't think you could even leave it in a hot car for a while. A building product should be able to survive a ride with UPS.

Probably ok for situations where sand contamination isn't an issue.. Works, but low quality.
I ended up running a pipe die on the inside to clear up some surface porosity and cleaned up the inside (non threaded portion) to remove some casting sand.

Threads weak. Threads in these broke on the first removal. Ruined several expensive stainless steel bolts when I tried to unscrew them. They jammed up on the bolt, and had to be cut off with a grinder. Cheap Chinese stainless I suspect.

Would be a decent cart if the right parts were .... Would be a decent cart if the right parts were in the box. Returned one with a missing screw and washer. Received another one with two missing screws and washer.
Does not fit. The 6.5mm caps are advertised as fitting 1/4" threads, but they do not. They fall right off.

pretty much junk. I received them in a timely manner. At first glance they looked ok. I needed a snap ring for my motorcycle so I tried what I though was the correct size. It was too big so I tried the next smaller size. They weren't really snap rings. Instead of holes for the snap ring plier, they had an indentation. They could not be spread with the pliers, I changed the pliers and after several tries go the ring to spread. because it did not have holes it popped off. Also it was bent out of shape so it appears they would not spring back into shape. These issues mean that they are useless and a waste of money. Junk out of poor steel and not shaped properly.
Print Bed Cracked after 4 prints!. It's a lovely printer, except that the glass/ceramic print bed broke after only a few prints.

Very disappointed.. Item received was not what was pictured. Item was marked ever .5ml with lines, and had blue caps. Specifically choose this product because tube show is clear (no lines) and white cap.
Also the caps do not fit - they are too small, therefore they do not stay on the tube, and they wobble - which would not keep the contents secure, at all.
Very disappointed.

Not a good deal. The same size 305 SS screws are 1/2 the price at Lowe’s, but we needed them delivered, so we tried these. They snap off and strip easier than the others, and if you have to unscrew them, they get just a shot as a cadmium plated screw. Other 305 Ss screws don’t hold the heat as well.

Filter is useless. This product was such a disappointment. The paper filers hat held on by a plastic ring. There’s nothing to lock the ring in place, so the filter can slide down, sending dust out the back of the vacuum and into your room. Although it doesn’t look like it, rounded bottom makes the vac easy to tip over since it’s too heavy with the motor at the top. When it tips the filter slides down just enough to send dust out the back as well. I also (my fault) stepped on the hose. It easily cracked. What a piece of junk. I bought another brand with a proper filter and am much happier.

DAMAGED. Mine came damaged! and when holding the tubing next to my master cardiology stethoscope tubing, this tubing is visibly smaller than the original tubing of my master cardiology stethoscope. especially the piece that you slide the bell into. complete waste of money!!! do they now LOOK at the product before shipping it or anything? it’s visibly damaged.

***UPDATE***
i was able to fit my master cardiology bell into the end (previously mentioned difference in size of tubing) however it is as you can see damaged so it doesn’t look very good. but i did want to say it does fit. the sound is also suitable.

Boric acid effectiveness for bug control. Product arrived in a sealed plastic bag with a ziplock closure. Within the bag much of it was lumpy, which could be somewhat made less of a problem by beating the sealed with a rubber mallet to crush lumps. Unfortunately, many lumps and granules remain which are waste.

The use of boric acid for insect control is via a puffer spreading a light coating of boric acid powder ov areas used by insects . So, while the price for quantity was excellent, the price per use is high because of the waste.

There may be a problem in the packing from bulk to one pound bags?

bent. I am honestly disappointed by this product. It arrived bent! The quality is not great. The bearings are garbage. This is not for precision builds like a CNC or 3D Printer. The bearing mounts is the only thing that work.

Arrived rusted and pitted.. Arrived already heavily rusted and pitted affecting its utility as a smooth and consistent ball bearing.

I purchased several other bearings from BC Precision at the same time all with the same issue of not living up the advertised material or product image. The price is low but I will not buy from them again unless I don't care about product accuracy.

It has three pins.. I was in a pinch and needed this Triac quick for a customer repair, and as usual it arrived quickly. It is a great looking part, with three well-defined leads in a TO220 package. But the love ends there, as not all things with three pins have the same internal qualities, and therefore cannot be used as a Triac despite the correct pin count and correct general shape. A close inspection of the details, despite my limited eyesight, proved that tube-to-bag process was unhinged, resulting in an unwanted DC voltage regulator.

Stand by to be searching for the battery cover every TIME you use it.. Had it a year now, no battery cover, just some folded up foil and a bread tie. It has pissed me off so many time due to loss of battery contact because of the cheezy battery cover, loose contact, loose readings!
I wouldn't trust it precision, but it makes it easy to find the right drill bit or pipe size, etc... Not bearing clearances, etc...

Piece of junk. Buyer beware! This one is a piece of junk! I did my due diligence and shopped around for a good touchless soap dispenser. The one I had before this I bought in a local store and had for years - I looked at all the ones on Amazon because the local store no longer sells these. I checked out all the reviews and chose this one thinking it had the best reviews. I put my soap in it, the batteries, put my hand under it and it tried to pump...over and over, to no avail. I read the instructions, removed the soap and put in warm soapy water? Nothing. On its way back and I will see if another one is better now. Extremely disappointed. I also had to laugh -- when it arrived my husband was shocked at the size of it, said it was an "industrial sized" dispenser!
Must be made in China and of low quality. 90% of them snapped off at the thread/shank which created a bigger problem had to return them. That process went good
Valve leaks. This valve leak when closed. Fitting are great but the value is garbage

Does Not Last Long. Does not last. I have hung 1 picture twice & a small mirror twice. Both have fallen off the wall after a few months. The first time I thought maybe I did not put enough strips, so I doubled it. A few months later both have fallen off. The mirror fell onto carpet so did not break. The other the frame got a small crack. Yesterday I noticed it was crooked & the room thermostat was keeping it up. Both are up the old fashion way...with a screw. Do not risk your pictures crashing on to the floor & getting damage.

On second thought, two bad design flaws. I fixed both.. As mentioned in other reviews, the 'hose' is bent/kinked that comes with the tank.I used a washing machine inlet hose instead of the original. But then, on actually using the grey water tank on a camping trip, I found that I could not EMPTY it completely. The drain hole's are not low enough on the tank to let the liquid out all the way. Bummer. This tank is Half the price of the 'other guys' blue tanks. MY FIX; I made another drain hole by using 3/4 threaded coupler with two nut washers to put on each side of the tank with silicone. The hard part was getting my big hand thru the large drain hole to tighten the inside nut. I used my wood burner to melt the new hole in the lower corner of the tank, it works awesome now. Total cost of the repair was under 5 bucks. Not bad for a 67 yr. old woman. I would post a photo but don't see a place to do that here.

These are the strangest brushes. I painted a picture .... These are the strangest brushes. I painted a picture with them, and I was finally so frustrated with them that I put them away and took out my other brushes.
The problem is really the largest one. I used it and the smallest one. It doesn't keep its shape. When it bends, it stays that way.
Not stainless steel!. Seems to be more nickel plated, not stainless steel. Lots of places are not plated. I expect lots of rust.

Don't buy if you can't solder. While I got this to work, I can't recommend it to others.

The wiring harness that came with the kit was too short. It interfered with the Y carriage travel. After a month of email with Comgrow I gave up on getting the correct part and soldered longer wires to the harness and got everything to work.

While the upper bearing supports that came with the kit were of very nice quality, I wouldn't use them as they jam up the z axis making it very hard to rotate. Without them everything moved smoothly.

Dried Out After 3rd Use Despite CAREFUL Cap Closure. why can't someone manufacturer super glue to last more than one or 2 uses before they complete harden? this glue adheres amazingly well. both Gorilla Super and Wood glues do (glued a broken piece of the bottom of the gate to my fence ten years ago and it's still holding, with gravity and opening and shutting). but this glue was terrible to use after the first time, barely came out despite my seasoned know-how of sealing it back up. pass on this glue or get it at half this price.

Great meter, but un-repairable. I have two of these. One has served me well for years and continues to do so. Bought a second to keep in 2nd tool bag and ~1 year later, maybe a dozen uses, and the clamp hinge breaks apart. This was almost a brand-new meter, lived its whole life in a case, never dropped, barely used, factory protector not even off the screen. Defect or not, the clamp is not a "user replaceable part" and Fluke does not sell it. There is no technical reason - the clamp and cable just come out, you don't even need to tools!

The manual even refers to the clamp *cable* as being a wear-item and replaceable, but neither the cable or the clamp assembly is listed as a part. Perhaps you can send them in for repair, but contacting Fluke's repair center is difficult to contact and, judging by the number of broken meters on ebay, probably not cost-effective.

Very disappointing product and customer experience from a company that otherwise leads the multimeter field.

Arrived broken/defective!!. DO NOT BUY, one of the tubes won't stay screwed in and keeps falling out!!! How on earth did it pass inspection?? And it is not eligible for return!! (I never would have bought this if it said that at checkout.) I have attached two photos of the defective stethoscope that shows the defective tube that doesn't stay screwed in and the tube even appears shorter!

UPDATE: I contacted ScrubMaster, worst customer service. Refuse to do anything, refund or replace. Just told me to contact me Amazon even though I repeatedly them then I did already. I would never buy anything from SrcubMaster again now after this experience. Horrible seller!!

Too mad to title this. First try at using this is now my last try. The little tube cracked and didn't realize the glue had run down 3 fingers on both hands. By the time I ran back inside the house all my fingers were stuck together and not coming apart. I had to drive as quick as I could to the store (it was dry so it didn't stick to the steering wheel)
and by super strength acetone to get it off. 15 to 20 minutes soaking my fingers in a little bowl with the acetone finally did the trick. I don't know what or why that tube just cracked leaking glue every where.
This product works very well sticking on things. It wasn't meant to glue your fingers together....
Not all pieces were there. This arrived on time, in great packaging, but there were pieces missing and no instructions.

Top comes off so easily when screwed down i do not trust them. After filling the bottle with black paint and screwing on the cap i went to take a piece of tape off the side. The cap came off spilling black paint all over my hsnd and the workbench.

The threads are so small that they do not hold the cap in well at all. Ir comes off so easily when screwed down i do not trust them.

Broken. Arrived broken. Of course I didn’t open and use immediately so I missed the return window. That’s on me but I guess I didn’t even think it would be broken upon arrival. By broken I mean will not turn on.

Very tiring. I too am glad I only use it for small jobs like a small beroom or furniture. Leaks like crazy and I've already had to have it repaired under warranty. Does a good job when you use it but it wears you out quickly.....

Poorly made. These are most likely roll formed to shape the outside threads, cold headed to form the hex feature, then the internal diameter is drilled and the internal thread is cut. The outside threads are okay, but show evidence of being over de-burred. The hex is okay. The inside threads are all over the map, but generally very poorly done. They would not pass inspection in any manufacturing company I have worked for. Will they work holding furniture together? Maybe, but here we go again Amazon, no control over the stuff you are selling. This is junk.

Quit working. Quit working after a couple weeks tried new batteries nothing would show on screen. Unfortunately after it quit working my husband accidentally left the freezer drawer open, had it worked it would have alerted us!

I would not trust this switch to turn off a light bulb.. Way too flimsy connection between the actuator arm and switch shaft. Overall too much play in the entire mechanism to be reliably repeatable. You should not use this switch for machine motion control.
I returned it.. It has small parts attached to it with screws which were loose. When I went to tighten them, one screw instantly stripped with hardly any force.
cheap. pipe cleaner doesnt fit inside the droppers, and actually broke the tips of mine when i attemted to clean them. also rubber caps were deformed. never even got to try and use them.
Thread would not match up to pump. These was waste of big bucks threads would not match up to pump so you could not use quick disconect. Total junk.

You Already Have a Better Tool—It is Called a Vacuum. The threads into which you insert the handle are rubber—that will not hold-up over time. More importantly, the effort to productivity ratio is low. It took much more effort than the vacuum and it did not get everything. So, after you have raked the carpet, you need to get out the vacuum to suck-up what you did rake, as well as everything else the rake missed. A silly product.

absolute junk. I was happy to get the drywall anchors all in one box for reasonable price. I received it all mixed, but no complain I was expecting that after reading reviews. My main complain is quality of anchors and screws. The anchors do not open inside the wall even when your put the screw through, Screws metal are so substandard 2 broke in the middle while installing (first time I saw that). This will turn your worst nightmare into reality, you think the anchor is gonna take the weight of the item / furniture / frame then one day 'Booom' you see the anchor came out and your beautiful piece of art / furniture / mirror is not garbage.

horrible customer service. If the seller ever gives me a tracking number for this product and then delivers it I may change my rating. So far Amazon has an expected delivery date of Yesterday for this product and advised me to contact the seller for more information on delivery. I have tried contacting this seller several times only to get auto-replies. All I want is a tracking number so I can look for the package with whatever carrier they used. But they will not give the tracking number to me nor have they had the product delivered. I suppose next step is to cancel an never order fro Bissell.

Don’t buy not new items. When this item arrived the item inside the box the box was open the nails were all over the shipping box the original box didn’t even have an end on it
Do not buy it didn’t come as a new product

Melted upon arrival. I went to use these today and realized that all but 4 of them were MELTED. The plastic is all warped and some of them are physically stuck together. Needless to say, they aren't useable. Wouldn't recommend ordering during an Arizona summer...
One Star. Switch failed within a week of using 3-5 times per day. The internal spring broke.
Waste of money. Less than 4 months after the initial purchase and 3 of the 4 are broken. Very cheap. Bought for the braided cord, they're nice but the main components fail.

FALSE ADVERTISING doesnt fit all litmanns. Gave as gift, and bought it because it said FIT A LITMANN. It BARELY fits in the case. It is NOT "roomy" as it is advertised, if you have one of the high end better littman stethoscopes. Even though the ad clearly states they fit. You have to do a lot of bunching up and twisting to get it to fit, which cant be good for the tubing. My opinion, not worth $ due to false advertising.

Great looking! That's about all.. Well! The printer arrived well packaged but was missing the black printing vinyl or whatever the material is supposed to be. I overlooked this because the printer appeared to be very sturdy and very easy to assemble. It comes with a plastic rule to adjust the Zed axis height. Once assembled, the Zed adjusted & the bed leveled, I printed a benchy. Great! I was impressed. Then it went down hill from there. The Zed axis height will not maintain a synced height between both steppers. Every print after that required readjustment of the axis. The print quality is very good if you can keep it adjusted. Something is very wrong and I will package it up and send it back.

"Superior strength and durability"??? Durable Corners"???. Failed both tests in shipping. Bashed corner and gash in side of top. The 1/2 inch hollow core top (pressed dimples on reverse side for topside support) wil not substitute for a solid top.

Doesn't fit print head for Ultimaker 2+. The threading of these nozzles don't quite fit the print head of my 2018 Ultimaker 2+. They do not screw into the print head. I can not find any way to contact the company.
wrong size.. despite this being labeled a 5M section it is not a 5mm pitch belt as it should be, it is a 2mm pitch belt. Disappointed.

non-existent customer service from Koldfront. Worked well for almost three years, which I would normally give four stars for, however it abruptly stopped cooling. I have called all over my fairly large city and no one provides service for these. The customer service at Koldfront is horrible---their solution is to try unplugging for 24 hours and if that does not work for me to ship to them (at my cost) for repair. Just the shipping there and back will be more than I paid for the original. My advice -- spend a little more and buy a name brand like Whirlpool or buy directly from in your town where you are sure you can get service.

Hate it. Piece of junk. Broke within minutes of putting it on. We were having a reception at our house so father-in-law tack welding it. It broke again. Not worth 2 cents. Warning don't waste your money!!!!
used it for the first and last time. used it to move a washing machine, no way the washer weighed more than 264lbs wheel broke right off.

faulty, maybe a dud?. did not hold any pressure at all before it broke open. not sure if it was a faulty seam or what but did not work for me, had to cut and cap the pipe to get the job done that night.
Flimsy. Didn't fit exactly - seemed to be a manufacturing error- then latch handle broke off while trying to install.

Don't waste your money!!!. I purchased this to leave in the freezer in our non-functioning ice-maker as we are now bringing in bag ice. My first mistake was trying to pick it up. Handle froze to my fingers. (Should have probably anticipated that.) Now we have the handle wrapped in electrical tape so you can actually pick it up. Second problem is that the length of the handle is almost comical. It is too short!!! It appears longer in the picture. It looks like a little stubby thumb. I have no problems with the scoop itself. I did read other comments that said not to put it into the dishwasher and I haven't, so it hasn't lost the coloring as others mentioned. I honestly would never buy this one again.

received a contaminated device!. I can see that this is a used/defective item. Right out of box the electrode has a clear build up of salt, calcium or possibly battery corrosion fluid and a piece of dirt or debris

Waste of money and time. It looked like a legitimate 3M command strip, however none of the strips would stick to my wall OR picture frames after several attempts at hanging my frames. Even peeling off the paper backing stripped the adhesive off of the strips. Go to a hardware store/Target/whatever to make sure you're actually buying the right thing.

Not a dental mirror.. I needed a dental mirror. This came up so I bought it. Unless you have a mouth like a Hippo this is not for you. Way to big to fit in a mouth. I returned it. I didn't take it out of the package because I could see that it was not a dental mirror. It might be a really good mirror for other uses but not to be able to see inside your mouth.

Good idea bad quality control. Good idea bad quality control. When I took the straps out of the box I noticed that one strap had a 6 inch frayed section where the whole strap is just hang on threads. Needless to say I could not use these for any kind of lifting. Very disappointed. Did not see this flaw for a long time after I received them otherwise I would have sent them back.

Low Quality Control. I advise to stay away from this filament tested it due to price and its not worth it. The filament 50% thru was knotted when rolled at factory, also it has small kinks and the advertised .02 tolerance is +_5% variance or more from being created or rolled onto the holder that cause issues with the machine. I have an Ender 3.

Good but breaks eaisly. After a dozen flawless prints, my last print tore a big chunk of glass out. The bed had cooled to room temperature and should have come off without any effort like the previous prints. The glass also has some kind of adhesive backing and is now impossible to remove without breaking it further or damaging my metal print surface.

Too stiff, too pricey. These require a lot of force to type. So they are definitely not recommended for gaming. For typing, you're fingers will tire out too soon. This is ideal for a business setting, someone typing something into a terminal like in a mechanic shop. The stiff switches are ideal from preventing typos and short amounts of typing.

Quality is severely lacking. I bought the 1" model with base. Upon opening the device was in. I pressed the power button and it turned off for about 5 seconds then back in. I checked the instructions "which basically do not exist" and there is no auto on feature. I tried different methods to force it back on by any means than the power button, and nothing seems to trigger it on other than pure randomness. The inside of the case, and the base afe covered in oil, to the point it is soaked into the foam. Those is absolutely no reason for this to be covered in oil. I can only guess it's a rust prevention method for pre shipping, which indicates it is made it garbage material. Also the additional data adapter is of poor design. Instead of the 400 warnings not to use a usb, they should have spent a few cents for a non usb adapter to prevent accidents. Probably would have been cheaper than the additional cost of ink to write the warnings.

To good to be true. I should have known for the price they wouldn't be any good. Broke four of them trying to install only two. You can't spread the arms at all without them snapping off. Hard plastic fins break off during installation. I ordered 2 sizes, from 2 different manufacturers to replace the foot caps on my patio set. The 1" caps installed easily, and the rubberized fins folded as they were pressed in, maintaining proper pressure against the interior sidewalls to keep the cap in place. But these 1-1/4" caps are made with a harder plastic material. When you press them in (or give them a mallet tap), they tend to break off. I gave them 2 stars because not all the fins come off. The leading edges of the caps shear off. Some break off completely, some get wedged in between the cap and the side wall of the tube. However, eventually they'll fall out and the cap will come loose. The manufacturer needs to reevaluate the composition of the plastic material they use. It's a balance: The softer the material, the quicker you caps will wear out, especially on rough hard surfaces like concrete. But the harder the material, the more likely it is you'll damage the fins during installation.

When ordering arbor bearings 15mm does NOT! equal to 5/8".---15mm is too small. I have an older Craftsman table saw with bad arbor bearings. I removed the arbor from the saw and extracted the bearings which had a # of 6202Z, I proceeded to Amazon and entered "Craftsman table saw arbor bearings with the number 6202Z". This is one of the items that came up, (((2 Pcs 6202 Z 15mm x 35mm x 11mm Single Row Wheel Roller Shielded Deep Groove Ball Radial B))) When they were delivered I attempted to put the unit back together. (((the bearings sent with the exact same number as the old which I had remove. The arbor shaft is 5/8 inch in diameter, the bearings are 15mm in diameter. Food for thought, 15mm is approximately 1mm smaller than 5/8". THAT BEING SAID ---make sure when you purchase replacement arbor bearings for an older Craftsman saw make sure the measurement of the arbor shaft size is measured in EXACTLY US MEASUREMENT 5/8 " Hope this helps someone (with His blessings Jim) NOTE (make sure they state 5/8" in the description)

Wet and brittle. I am reducing my rating from 3 stats to 1. Right out of the box it started to break. It snapped four times during the first 24 hours of prints, leaving me with either failed prints or lots of stringing/oozing from failed retractions and overall poor flow control. Lots of popping at the nozzle, too. Adhesion and print quality were affected by this.

After drying it out, popping was reduced but it continued to break regularly. 100% of my prints were affected by the filament breaking at least once either at the extruder, somewhere in the Bowden tube, or inside the dry box simply coming off the spool. Every print had to be re-started at least once because of broken filament. If I left it loaded in the printer overnight the filament would break somewhere between the spool and the extruder. No other filament has ever had this problem.

Based on these experiences, I cannot recommend 3D Solutech filament at all.

Shot Craps & Lost - - Not US NPT Pipe threads. I keep getting sucked into this quagmire, While these valves are advertised as 1/2 in. NPT ports in the details, (all sizes say NPT in details), these valves all are British BSPT straight threads and NPT nipples or male pipe will bottom out and not seal correctly. I had seen the feedback about the problem with less detail. I shot craps knowing that I was using very low pressure and could use an adapter if necessary. You can buy these. I have before when this happened. Your first hint of trouble is that the AC voltage is listed as 110 Vac - - and this is the Chinese AC line voltage when not 220V. I live in China part of the year. China uses mostly BSPT threads in their plumbing. This seller is trying to hawk Chinese valves in the USA and he knows better. By the way, if used with "ON" duty cycle that is high, these valves will run hot and not be reliable when run on USA 120 Vac line or even higher is worse. Most USA line voltage is now approaching 130 Vac,, Look out for that too. Safety, possible flood and fire issue.

Junk. There was a small crack in 1/2" CPVC water pipe that was dripping. Bought this from Ace, which gouged me double price as I could get it on line or a box store. Cable broke, image not great.. I use the camera twice. The image is not great, but it would give me an idea. First time I inspected the inside of a 2" pipe.

Oily and dirty. The item is exactly what was needed and being replaced on my 3D printer. Cute but fall apart easily. I bought this for my child to wear to school. This is my second round of disposable masks intended for this purpose. The designs are cute and my daughter liked them. We didn't have issues with the other rounds of disposable masks falling apart. These masks easily pull apart at the strings. She wears these all day during gym class and recess. She didn't have any problems keeping the others intact. I would say overall there is something less secure about the strings that attach to the ears. Waste of money and no peace of mind that my kid has a well fitting mask on all day.

Not as advertised. As other reviewers have noted, this item does not come as pictured. The band is stainless but the screw is NOT, even though the one in the photo clearly is. Once the screw rusts it will either fall apart or become impossible to remove. This means there is no reason for the rest of it to be stainless, as they say, a chain is only as strong as the weakest link. The weak link here is the screw. Very disappointed that a made in USA product is so cheap and shoddy, and making false claims.

Belt length not in spec. Sold as an A24/4L260 which should be 26 inches long around the top of the belt. What they shipped is labeled A24/4L260 but is almost 27 inches long. Very loose on my belt sander.

Poorly built product. I am on my second CR-10 S5 now. The first one worked and printed just fine except the printer bed would not heat up at all out of the box. It seems the control box is for a 200x200 machine, as when I go to do a bed leveling it only goes 200mm in from the bottom right corner. Good Wood Screw, Bad Product Description. Not happy with this. No where on the product's Amazon page does it state that the package contained only 2 screws. There is nothing wrong with the screw, just that the product description is useless.

Sturdy time-saver, bud didn't last long. I have a ton of keys for work, and this thing has helped immensely with retrieving my keys. They collapse inwards when you use them!. Excellent quality bottles, but the spray heads don't have any pressure relief valve. This results in the bottle getting crushed from the vaccum that is created by simply using the sprayer as intended.
I can't use them. But I can't return them either because we put chemical ID labels on them already. Our chandelier repair techs brought them back to the shop after one day of use.

Are we the only buyers with this problem? Perhaps a few gentle mists per day on a houseplant would not produce the same problem. However, if I wanted a toy sprayer I would have bought one at Walmart for $0.69.

These are supposed to be high quality sprayers, not toys.

What chemicals did we put in them? Deionized water. So it's not like we were exceeding the design limitations of the sprayer.

I'd like a refund, or a replacement if the seller believes that we received defective goods. I'll update as soon as we find out how they intend to resolve this issue.
Garbage. Thread is so fine these will strip right out of whatever you are trying to drive them into.
it leaks all over the place. no good clamp that holds it tight not tight. you need special to clamp it with, and I have one clamp it all the way still leaks. not as pictured

Great bottles, cheap caps. They leak. Great bottles, cheap caps. I bought these to create my own fragrances using essential oils. Didn’t work at all. I tried to repair my brass ash spatula. Followed the directions. The glue was black and messy, and stuck to my fingers. The worst part - it didn’t hold my spatula at all. Broke as I lifted it up.

EXTREMELY BAD PACKAGING! Broken. Okay, so I had originally ordered a pack of 6 roller balls that looked just like this from another company. I was so happy with them, I needed more. So I ordered these.
I was so disappointed when I opened the box. None of the roller ball and screw caps where in a bag of there own, along with the dropper. They were all shoved on top of the bottles, bent, broken. You will not receive the item as pictured.. A Type D I/M fitting is likely what you need, (what's pictured), and what I needed, but what these are not. The fitting which ships are a high flow industrial Type "V" x 1/4" Male NPT (National Pipe Thread), quick release pneumatic fitting. The fittings pictured are the most common automotive style fittings. Personally, I switched from a "T" type quick connect, but remember, none of these described fittings are interchangeable. See the attached image to see what shipped and how it differs from what I was looking for, (what is pictured in this vendors ad.) They shipped the one on the right.
Good luck

Now the Pros:

Less of an odor

That is all

Not a detailed skull for chiro students. I am a doctor of chiropractic student. Looking at this skull I would say this is more for a basic osteo/anatomy class. There are a lot of foramina missing or they are not drilled all the way through. The optic canal is inexistent and marked on the skull on the frontal bone instead of the sphenoid and merged with the supraorbial fissure. Minor sutures missing. Nuchal lines not visible except the superior one. Carotid foramen cannot be seen internally only the external opening - not drilled through. Glabella not there. Sulcus for superior sagittal sinus inexistent. Chiasmatic groove- i guess you can guess where it is at but the groove itself is not in the skull. Zygomatico-frontal-temporal-facial foramina all missing. Pteygomaxillary fissure with pterigopalatine fossa- inexistent At this point I plan on returning it.

It didn’t matter how hard I crimped either. If I wiggles the wires, the tweeters would turn on and off. I don’t recommend these.

Good Adhesive, but backing breaks A LOT!!. I really wanted this product to work and not believe the other reviews. The adhesive itself is really good. As a side note, I have had this happen when using the Scotch brand as well. I however rate it a 2 because, like in other reviews, the backing breaks mid-roll. I'm not talking breaking once or twice...it's MULTIPLE times. There is no rhyme or reason as to where the break is located. You could get in 1/3 of the way through the roll or one-foot into the roll. I wish there was another way to dispense this because I really do like the adhesive (and the price). Once I frustratingly make it through the SIX (ugh) rolls I ordered I will not order again.

8 lids, first year, broke, leak, loose seals, wet dog & chicken feeds. Bought 9 months ago, all are not discarded or used indoors only due to breakage, leakage and loose seals. Outdoor pail had wet feed after 1 night of rain. Indoor bucket had moldy feed after 2 weeks in dry storage. Several bags of chicken layer pellets have been discarded due to mold & wet.
Pizza pans keep water out of feed better than these lids.

Bottle won't open. Kinda hard to review something I can't use. The B bottle was a PITA to open. A? The resin? Sealed shut, it must be. Not recommended. I bought this to fix a hole in my hose and it didn’t work. The water went right through it so the leak was not patched.

In between one of the tries, I printed with another PLA+ color I had, and it did fine. Put the black back in and it clogged again.

Poor package design leads to wasted wipes. We just switched from pampers to huggies after 3 years with pampers wipes. The packaging for pampers is just so lacking. The little adhesive flap closure doesn’t seal and the top wipes dry out. And for some reason the way the wipes are folded together makes it very difficult to pull out one wipe at a time so you end up using 5 even if you only need 1. The quality of the wipes themselves is very good and if you have a good wipe dispenser these issues would probably be resolved, but with a new baby we have wipe packages scattered throughout the house and don’t use a dispenser at every location. We started going through the wipes way too quickly and were wasting not only wipes but money too. The huggies package is much better - solid plastic flip top that seals shut and wipes are folded in a way that allows one at a time to come out.

Seeing that pampers is more expensive, and supposed to be a step above huggies, I would think their package design would be much better. Even Sam’s club wipes have a better package design - similar to huggies with the hard plastic flip top.

Try using Tide Simply Oxi first. I ordered this product, and when I opened up the delivery package, the product container was damaged and was unusable. Instead of reordering the product, I decided to try Tide detergent Simply Oxi. I used it at full strength, and used a nylon brush to make sure the Detergent was covering all of the oils spills. I let it soak in while we went to church. Upon returning home, the oil stains...all of them....were gone. I used a hose to wash off the detergent. So folks...before spending money on oil cleaning solutions, give Tide Simply Oxi, a try.

ORECK QUALITY HAS DROPPED!. There's nothing like an Oreck! I appreciate that they're lightweight, reliable, and relatively low-cost. After owning many Orecks over the past couple decades (our pets are really hard on vacuums, and we have a large 2-story house), I went off-course and bought a competitor's -- big mistake! My latest Oreck is "plain Jane," with no fancy and unnecessary geegaws -- its one setting gobbles up debris on both carpeting and tile flooring, with a single pass. I especially love its extra-long and substantial cord (far less likely to sucked up by the rollers if accidentally run over).
Highly recommend!

UPDATE: After only 3 months, cheap plastic brush roller has melted! Vacuum repairman informed me Oreck is now owned by Hoover, and quality has plummeted. He installed a proper (not plastic!!) brush roller, as well as new belt. After decades of happily owning Orecks, I'm shocked at this situation.

Not as pictured. I ordered these (2" long) because I need to replace the bolts that hold the cap on the hubs of my rear axles. Mechanic only had Grade 5. Horrible!. Would give 0 stars if I could... The ring cutter broke before we were even half way through a VERY thin band. I hate it. Please don't waste your money.

It is CRACKED all over. See pics.. Item arrived defective and have crack all over. I can’t believe the quality is this bad.

Not your average "eastern alternative" -- Updated. This thing is made well and everything fits perfect and straight. The tolerances are tight and all the threads feel like they locked strong. I'll not buy this brand again as I had so many problems trying to get through this one spool.

Dangerously thin, but most are.. If you going to insulate a 0 or thicker wire you potentially risking a short of hundreds of amps DC or dozens of AC amps. The MILAPEAK 180 PCS Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Grade Shrink Wrap - Industrial Heat-Shrink Tubing is less about 15 thousandths of in inch thick. you would never see anything using that much amperage using such a flimsy insulator, it's insane. In all fairness this insanity seems to be a standard in the after market heat shrink industry but someone seriously needs to call them on this. If it's a DC circuit your risking circuit damage or fire. On an AC circuit you could burn down your house or electrocute someone.

Way too stiff for a mini split compressor; cracked after 4 months. When looking for vibration damping mounts for your mini split compressor, more weight is not better. It’s worse.
This product will support up to 800lbs (200lbs per corner). My compressor is only 85lbs, which means this rubber is way, way too hard to dampen any vibrations from my 12k btu mini split. I can’t believe they are marketing this to mini split owners. Most compressors don’t exceed 200lbs.

Another problem is that it is natural rubber which wears out in UV light and temperature extremes. Neoprene or some other newer material would have been better for longevity’s sake. I am looking at seismic spring mounts now. Make sure to match your unit’s weight to the weight indicated on the product closely or else it will just transmit the vibration through the structure.

Update 7/1/20: my contractor took off these worthless Chinese mounts and put on some real spring mounts. They were cracking after only 4 months!!

This creates more problems than solving them.. Had high hopes for this.
It's actually good quality and SOLID, but probably too solid.
But if you install this, be prepared for Z lead screw binding and new noises that weren't there before... and possibly shortening the life or motor and Z lead screw.

The Z rod brass nut (loosened) on the Ender 3 (Pro) is meant to provide a small amount of play to PREVENT binding. When you add this mount, it doesn't allow this needed play. It creates a bind.

Depending on the build tolerance of your printer, you may notice the Z motor may be shifted too far back. Thats not a big deal as the brass z rod nut will help with that, but once you install the top mount, it will constrict the top of the z rod and actually bend the rod in an arc.

Have not tried the 3d printed top mount. But hear is better as it may provide "more give"? I find NOT using this metal top mount is better and probably a reason why Creality didn't incorporate it.

Because there is hardly any lube and mostly solvent that actually washes OUT grease and oil! It is a wonderful product to SELL to folks trying to quiet a squeaky bit AWFUL for the buyer because such a tiny amount of lube and so you have to keep spraying more and more and more to keep it quiet .....genius product to profit SELLER but LOUSY lubircation for consumer! Badly machined parts prevents use. As one other reviewer here has mentioned the mounting boss for the moving arm is too short

in the first picture at the top of the page. it is the top row of small parts, second to last to the right hand side. The "T" shaped tube just to the left of the bearing grooved-roller.

This needs to be a little longer than the fulcrum hole in the moving arm so that when you attach this boss to the frame with the long black socket head bolt, it tightens against the frame. The moving arm should still be free to move but as it now is, it clamps arm against the frame.

You need to carefully drill the counter-bore in the moving arm fulcrum hole about 1mm deeper. Then it will allow the bolt to hold the boss tightly against the frame and still let the moving rm move.

Or, you may be able to find a small flat washer to put between the frame and the boss to hold it out far enough for the moving arm to do it's thing.

Connectors too small. First off, the screw connectors that allow you to attach wire to this are far to small, particularly for a 35 amp capacity switch! Try hooking #12 solid copper wire to them. Or even 14 gauge stranded. Severely under designed! Secondly, as many other reviewers have noted, this switch doesn’t fit easily into a normal electrical box, but with some minor modifications, I was able to do it. First, the mounting screws, washers, and hex nuts don’t have the standard screw threads that electrical boxes have. But if you ditch those, and pass a standard screw through the unthreaded mounting holes in the switch, they can then mount on a normal metal or plastic box. That brings up the second point, the mounting hole spacing on the switch does NOT line up with the hole spacing in a standard box. It is misaligned by a small amount. So I simply removed the stamped metal bracket from the switch that had the mounting holes, and in a drill press, enlarged the holes. Then they lined up with the mounting holes in a standard electrical box. I ended up using a regular 20 amp toggle switch that costs less than half.

Horrifyingly loud. This is just about the cheapest way you can possibly get tap water pressure, but it’s really not a great option. It’s LOUD. Like, power tool loud. I’m using it for an outdoor shower/hot tub heater combo, and I can’t in good conscience use it for heating after dark, because I have neighbors. I made some measurements with an iPhone app that should be relatively accurate (2dB): this pump read 68.5dB 2 meters away when balled up tightly in a towel to muffle it. Exposed, it measured a whopping 74.6dB.

By way of comparison, I replaced this with a 3x as expensive (but still reasonably priced) seaflo 4-chamber diaphragm pump model. That measures 52.6dB In open air, and actually I think much of that is the propane burner it’s feeding. It’s actually a little quieter than the hot tub’s built in circulation pump, which measured 52.7dB

So yeah. Use only if you have it stuffed away somewhere, if you can tolerate noise, and for short duration.

Very high failure rate (~20%), no easy way to tighten the nut. Out of twenty of these switches that I've installed, three failed immediately, and a fourth one is usually not working, and about half of them don't work 100% of the time. That's after just single-digit button presses per button. These things just do not work reliably. Part of it may be thermal sensitivity, as two of the three that failed right off the bat had to be soldered more than once, but either way, these things clearly are really not worth buying.

Additionally:

* The holes in the lugs are ridiculously tiny, which makes them kind of a pain to work with.
* The screw thread isn't tall enough to mount them on a plastic project box with the lock washer in place.
* The body is perfectly round, with no flat sides for gripping them to tighten down the nut.

At this point, I'll probably rip all of them out and throw them all away as soon as I'm not under a time crunch. Save your money and buy something better.
